notes:
• Find your starting point: a quick test of one move per push, pull, squat, hinge and core sets your first targets, with a harder or easier move suggested when one fits your gear, or an honest "top level" or "easiest version" when none does.
• Smarter sets: Hard means progress and Failure means hold; after a failed or missed set the next sets adjust, with an Undo.
• Plans fit you better: no-gear plans only use what you own, supersets and circuits, day warm-ups, a fat-loss split, and better reps, rest and order.
• Live workout: a smooth wavy rest bar, a rest timer that survives the app being closed, and fewer buttons on each set.
• Every exercise now has a picture, from open exercise image sets (credits in Settings).
• Fixes: long holds and big rep counts give sensible targets, records and charts use one capped max estimate, and warm-ups no longer count toward recovery.
